WITH s AS (SELECT postid, seed_time FROM {seeds}),
p AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time, p.creationdate AS created, p.owneruserid AS oid,
         length(coalesce(p.title,'')) AS title_len,
         length(coalesce(p.body,'')) AS body_len,
         length(coalesce(p.tags,'')) - length(replace(coalesce(p.tags,''),'<','')) AS n_tags,
         CASE WHEN p.owneruserid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_null
  FROM s JOIN posts p ON p.id = s.postid
),
v AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2) AS ups_all,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=3) AS downs_all,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=6) AS close_votes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=10) AS del_votes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=8) AS bounty_starts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '3 days') AS ups_3d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '7 days') AS ups_7d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '14 days') AS ups_14d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS ups_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS ups_91d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '182 days' AND vv.creationdate <= s.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS ups_91_182d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS ups_365d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '730 days') AS ups_730d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '730 days' AND vv.creationdate <= s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS ups_365_730d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate <= p.created + interval '7 days') AS ups_first_7d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate <= p.created + interval '30 days') AS ups_first_30d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS v_91d,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS v_30d,
    max(vv.creationdate) AS last_vote,
    max(vv.creationdate) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2) AS last_up
  FROM s LEFT JOIN votes vv ON vv.postid = s.postid AND vv.creationdate <= s.seed_time
       LEFT JOIN p ON p.postid = s.postid AND p.seed_time = s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ans AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS n_answers,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '7 days' AND a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS n_answers_7d,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '30 days' AND a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS n_answers_30d,
    count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '91 days' AND a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS n_answers_91d,
    min(a.creationdate) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS first_ans_time,
    max(a.creationdate) FILTER (WHERE a.creationdate <= s.seed_time) AS last_ans_time
  FROM s LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.parentid = s.postid AND a.posttypeid=2
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
av AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time, a.id AS aid,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2) AS a_ups,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=1) AS a_acc
  FROM s JOIN posts a ON a.parentid = s.postid AND a.posttypeid=2
       LEFT JOIN votes vv ON vv.postid = a.id AND vv.creationdate <= s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
ansv AS (
  SELECT postid, seed_time,
    sum(a_ups) AS ans_ups,
    sum(a_acc) AS n_accepted,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE a_ups > 0) AS ans_with_ups,
    max(a_ups) AS best_ans_ups,
    sum(a_ups) FILTER (WHERE a_ups > 0) AS ans_ups_pos
  FROM av GROUP BY 1,2
),
cm AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time,
    count(c.id) AS n_comments,
    count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '7 days') AS n_comments_7d,
    count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '30 days') AS n_comments_30d,
    count(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS n_comments_91d,
    max(c.creationdate) AS last_comment
  FROM s LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.postid = s.postid AND c.creationdate <= s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ph AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN (4,5)) AS n_edits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 5) AS n_body_edits,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid = 10) AS n_closed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN (4,5) AND ph.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS n_edits_91d,
    max(ph.creationdate) FILTER (WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN (4,5)) AS last_edit
  FROM s LEFT JOIN posthistory ph ON ph.postid = s.postid AND ph.creationdate <= s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
inb AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time, count(pl.id) AS n_in_links,
    count(pl.id) FILTER (WHERE pl.creationdate > s.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS n_in_links_365d
  FROM s LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON pl.relatedpostid = s.postid AND pl.creationdate <= s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
outb AS (
  SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time, count(pl.id) AS n_out_links
  FROM s LEFT JOIN postlinks pl ON pl.postid = s.postid AND pl.creationdate <= s.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ow AS (
  SELECT p.postid, p.seed_time,
    count(po.id) AS owner_posts,
    count(po.id) FILTER (WHERE po.posttypeid=1) AS owner_questions,
    count(po.id) FILTER (WHERE po.posttypeid=2) AS owner_answers,
    max(po.creationdate) AS owner_last_post
  FROM p JOIN posts po ON po.owneruserid = p.oid AND po.creationdate <= p.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
owv AS (
  SELECT p.postid, p.seed_time,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2) AS owner_ups_received,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2 AND vv.creationdate > p.seed_time - interval '365 days') AS owner_ups_received_365d
  FROM p JOIN posts po ON po.owneruserid = p.oid AND po.creationdate <= p.seed_time
         JOIN votes vv ON vv.postid = po.id AND vv.creationdate <= p.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ob AS (
  SELECT p.postid, p.seed_time,
    count(b.id) AS owner_badges,
    count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.class=1) AS owner_gold,
    count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.class=2) AS owner_silver
  FROM p JOIN badges b ON b.userid = p.oid AND b.date <= p.seed_time
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
us AS (
  SELECT p.postid, p.seed_time, extract(epoch FROM (p.seed_time - u.creationdate))/86400.0 AS acct_age_days
  FROM p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.oid
),
vday AS (
  SELECT vv.creationdate::date AS d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE vv.votetypeid=2) AS ups FROM votes vv GROUP BY 1
),
vst AS (
  SELECT t.seed_time,
    sum(coalesce(vday.ups,0)) FILTER (WHERE vday.d < t.seed_time::date AND vday.d > t.seed_time::date - 91) AS site_ups_91d,
    sum(coalesce(vday.ups,0)) FILTER (WHERE vday.d < t.seed_time::date - 90 AND vday.d > t.seed_time::date - 181) AS site_ups_prev91d
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT seed_time FROM {seeds}) t
  LEFT JOIN vday ON vday.d < t.seed_time::date
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.postid, s.seed_time,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - p.created))/86400.0 AS age_days,
  p.title_len, p.body_len, p.n_tags, p.owner_null,
  v.ups_all, v.downs_all, v.close_votes, v.del_votes, v.bounty_starts,
  v.ups_3d, v.ups_7d, v.ups_14d, v.ups_30d, v.ups_91d, v.ups_91_182d, v.ups_365d, v.ups_730d, v.ups_365_730d,
  v.ups_first_7d, v.ups_first_30d, v.v_91d, v.v_30d,
  v.ups_91d::numeric / (v.ups_all + 1) AS ups_frac_91d,
  v.ups_365d::numeric / (v.ups_all + 1) AS ups_frac_365d,
  v.ups_all::numeric / (extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - p.created))/86400.0 + 1) AS ups_per_day,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - v.last_vote))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_vote,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - v.last_up))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_up,
  coalesce(ans.n_answers,0) AS n_answers, coalesce(ans.n_answers_7d,0) AS n_answers_7d,
  coalesce(ans.n_answers_30d,0) AS n_answers_30d, coalesce(ans.n_answers_91d,0) AS n_answers_91d,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ans.first_ans_time))/86400.0 AS first_ans_days,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ans.last_ans_time))/86400.0 AS last_ans_days,
  coalesce(ansv.ans_ups,0) AS ans_ups, coalesce(ansv.n_accepted,0) AS n_accepted,
  coalesce(ansv.ans_with_ups,0) AS ans_with_ups, coalesce(ansv.best_ans_ups,0) AS best_ans_ups,
  coalesce(ansv.ans_ups_pos,0) AS ans_ups_pos,
  coalesce(cm.n_comments,0) AS n_comments, coalesce(cm.n_comments_7d,0) AS n_comments_7d,
  coalesce(cm.n_comments_30d,0) AS n_comments_30d, coalesce(cm.n_comments_91d,0) AS n_comments_91d,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - cm.last_comment))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_comment,
  coalesce(ph.n_edits,0) AS n_edits, coalesce(ph.n_body_edits,0) AS n_body_edits, coalesce(ph.n_closed,0) AS n_closed,
  coalesce(ph.n_edits_91d,0) AS n_edits_91d,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ph.last_edit))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_edit,
  least(extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - v.last_vote))/86400.0,
        extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ans.last_ans_time))/86400.0,
        extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - cm.last_comment))/86400.0,
        extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ph.last_edit))/86400.0) AS last_activity_days,
  (coalesce(v.ups_30d,0) + coalesce(cm.n_comments_30d,0) + coalesce(ans.n_answers_30d,0)) AS activity_30d,
  (coalesce(v.ups_91d,0) + coalesce(cm.n_comments_91d,0) + coalesce(ans.n_answers_91d,0)) AS activity_91d,
  coalesce(inb.n_in_links,0) AS n_in_links, coalesce(inb.n_in_links_365d,0) AS n_in_links_365d,
  coalesce(outb.n_out_links,0) AS n_out_links,
  coalesce(ow.owner_posts,0) AS owner_posts, coalesce(ow.owner_questions,0) AS owner_questions,
  coalesce(ow.owner_answers,0) AS owner_answers,
  extract(epoch FROM (s.seed_time - ow.owner_last_post))/86400.0 AS owner_last_post_days,
  coalesce(owv.owner_ups_received,0) AS owner_ups_received,
  coalesce(owv.owner_ups_received_365d,0) AS owner_ups_received_365d,
  coalesce(ob.owner_badges,0) AS owner_badges, coalesce(ob.owner_gold,0) AS owner_gold, coalesce(ob.owner_silver,0) AS owner_silver,
  us.acct_age_days,
  vst.site_ups_91d, vst.site_ups_prev91d,
  vst.site_ups_91d::numeric / (vst.site_ups_prev91d + 1) AS site_trend
FROM s
JOIN p ON p.postid = s.postid AND p.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN v ON v.postid = s.postid AND v.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN ans ON ans.postid = s.postid AND ans.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN ansv ON ansv.postid = s.postid AND ansv.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.postid = s.postid AND cm.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN ph ON ph.postid = s.postid AND ph.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN inb ON inb.postid = s.postid AND inb.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN outb ON outb.postid = s.postid AND outb.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN ow ON ow.postid = s.postid AND ow.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN owv ON owv.postid = s.postid AND owv.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN ob ON ob.postid = s.postid AND ob.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN us ON us.postid = s.postid AND us.seed_time = s.seed_time
LEFT JOIN vst ON vst.seed_time = s.seed_time

tagagg AS (

    count(*) FILTER (WHERE tp.pcreated <= tp.seed_time - interval '91 days') AS tag_q_prev90d,
    sum(coalesce(pgu.ups_91,0)) AS tag_ups_91d,

       from posthistory where userid is not null group by 1,2),
bg as (select userid uid, date::date d, count(*) n,
              count(*) filter (where class=1) c1,
              count(*) filter (where class=2) c2,
              count(*) filter (where class=3) c3
       from badges group by 1,2),
vg as (select p.owneruserid uid, v.creationdate::date d, count(*) n,
              count(*) filter (where v.votetypeid=2) up,
              count(*) filter (where v.votetypeid=3) dn
       from votes v join posts p on v.postid = p.id where p.owneruserid is not null group by 1,2),
crg as (select p.owneruserid uid, c.creationdate::date d, count(*) n
        from comments c join posts p on c.postid = p.id where p.owneruserid is not null group by 1,2),
fp as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n),0)::float8 p_all,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-7),0)::float8 p_7,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-30),0)::float8 p_30,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 p_91,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-182),0)::float8 p_182,

    coalesce(sum(pg.na),0)::float8 a_all,

    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-7),0)::float8 c_7,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-30),0)::float8 c_30,

    fc.c_all, fc.c_7, fc.c_30, fc.c_91, fc.c_182, fc.c_730, fc.c_days_all, fc.c_days_91, fc.c_np_all,

    fb.b_all, fb.b_91, fb.b_365, fb.b_days_all, fb.b_gold, fb.b_silver, fb.b_bronze, fb.dsf_badge,
    fv.vr_all, fv.vr_91, fv.vup_all, fv.vup_91, fv.vdn_all, fv.vdn_91,
    fr.cr_all, fr.cr_91,
    fu.acct_age, fu.acct_new_91
  from s
  join fp on fp.rn = s.rn
  join fc on fc.rn = s.rn
  join fh on fh.rn = s.rn
  join fb on fb.rn = s.rn
  join fv on fv.rn = s.rn
  join fr on fr.rn = s.rn
  join fu on fu.rn = s.rn

       from votes v join posts p on v.postid = p.id where p.owneruserid is not null group by 1,2),
crg as (select p.owneruserid uid, c.creationdate::date d, count(*) n
        from comments c join posts p on c.postid = p.id where p.owneruserid is not null group by 1,2),
fp as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n),0)::float8 p_all,
    coalesce(sum(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-7),0)::float8 p_7,

    coalesce(sum(pg.nq) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 q_91,
    coalesce(sum(pg.na) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 a_91,
    count(pg.d)::float8 p_days_all,
    count(pg.d) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-91)::float8 p_days_91,
    coalesce(max(pg.n) filter (where pg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 p_maxday_91,
    case when max(pg.d) is null then 10000 else (s.sd - max(pg.d))::float8 end dsl_post,
    case when min(pg.d) is null then 10000 else (s.sd - min(pg.d))::float8 end dsf_post
  from s left join pg on pg.uid = s.owneruserid and pg.d < s.sd
  group by s.rn, s.sd
),
fc as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n),0)::float8 c_all,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-7),0)::float8 c_7,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-30),0)::float8 c_30,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 c_91,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-182),0)::float8 c_182,
    coalesce(sum(cg.n) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-730),0)::float8 c_730,
    count(cg.d)::float8 c_days_all,
    count(cg.d) filter (where cg.d >= s.sd-91)::float8 c_days_91,
    coalesce(sum(cg.np),0)::float8 c_np_all,
    case when max(cg.d) is null then 10000 else (s.sd - max(cg.d))::float8 end dsl_comment
  from s left join cg on cg.uid = s.owneruserid and cg.d < s.sd
  group by s.rn, s.sd
),
fh as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(hg.n),0)::float8 h_all,
    coalesce(sum(hg.n) filter (where hg.d >= s.sd-7),0)::float8 h_7,
    coalesce(sum(hg.n) filter (where hg.d >= s.sd-30),0)::float8 h_30,
    coalesce(sum(hg.n) filter (where hg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 h_91,
    coalesce(sum(hg.n) filter (where hg.d >= s.sd-182),0)::float8 h_182,
    coalesce(sum(hg.ne),0)::float8 h_edit_all,
    coalesce(sum(hg.ne) filter (where hg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 h_edit_91,
    coalesce(sum(hg.np),0)::float8 h_np_all,

  group by s.rn, s.sd
),
fb as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(bg.n),0)::float8 b_all,
    coalesce(sum(bg.n) filter (where bg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 b_91,
    coalesce(sum(bg.n) filter (where bg.d >= s.sd-365),0)::float8 b_365,
    count(bg.d)::float8 b_days_all,
    coalesce(sum(bg.c1),0)::float8 b_gold,
    coalesce(sum(bg.c2),0)::float8 b_silver,
    coalesce(sum(bg.c3),0)::float8 b_bronze,
    case when max(bg.d) is null then 10000 else (s.sd - max(bg.d))::float8 end dsl_badge,

  from s left join bg on bg.uid = s.owneruserid and bg.d < s.sd

),
fv as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(vg.n),0)::float8 vr_all,
    coalesce(sum(vg.n) filter (where vg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 vr_91,
    coalesce(sum(vg.up),0)::float8 vup_all,
    coalesce(sum(vg.up) filter (where vg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 vup_91,

),
fr as (
  select s.rn,
    coalesce(sum(crg.n),0)::float8 cr_all,
    coalesce(sum(crg.n) filter (where crg.d >= s.sd-91),0)::float8 cr_91
  from s left join crg on crg.uid = s.owneruserid and crg.d < s.sd
  group by s.rn, s.sd
),
fu as (
  select s.rn,
    case when u.creationdate is null then -1 else (s.sd - u.creationdate::date)::float8 end acct_age,
    case when u.creationdate is null then 0 else (case when u.creationdate::date >= s.sd-91 then 1 else 0 end) end acct_new_91
  from s left join users u on u.id = s.owneruserid and u.creationdate < s.seed_time
),
c as (
  select s.owneruserid, s.seed_time,
    fp.dsl_post, fc.dsl_comment, fh.dsl_hist, fb.dsl_badge,
    least(fp.dsl_post, fc.dsl_comment, fh.dsl_hist, fb.dsl_badge) as f_dsl_activity,
    fp.p_all, fp.p_7, fp.p_30, fp.p_91, fp.p_182, fp.p_365, fp.p_730,
    fp.q_all, fp.a_all, fp.q_91, fp.a_91, fp.p_days_all, fp.p_days_91, fp.p_maxday_91, fp.dsf_post,
    fc.c_all, fc.c_7, fc.c_30, fc.c_91, fc.c_182, fc.c_730, fc.c_days_all, fc.c_days_91, fc.c_np_all,
    fh.h_all, fh.h_7, fh.h_30, fh.h_91, fh.h_182, fh.h_days_all, fh.h_edit_all, fh.h_edit_91, fh.h_np_all,
    fb.b_all, fb.b_91, fb.b_365, fb.b_days_all, fb.b_gold, fb.b_silver, fb.b_bronze, fb.dsf_badge,
    fv.vr_all, fv.vr_91, fv.vup_all, fv.vup_91, fv.vdn_all, fv.vdn_91,
    fr.cr_all, fr.cr_91,
    fu.acct_age, fu.acct_new_91
  from s
  join fp on fp.rn = s.rn
  join fc on fc.rn = s.rn
  join fh on fh.rn = s.rn
  join fb on fb.rn = s.rn
  join fv on fv.rn = s.rn
  join fr on fr.rn = s.rn
  join fu on fu.rn = s.rn
)
select c.*,
  (f_dsl_activity / (dsf_post + 1))::float8 as g_recency_ratio,
  ((p_365 + 1) / (p_all + 1))::float8 as g_p365_share,
  ((c_91 + c_30) / (c_all + 1))::float8 as g_c_recent_share,
  ((p_91 + c_91 + h_91) / (p_all + c_all + h_all + 1))::float8 as g_recent_share,
  ((vup_91 + 1) / (p_91 + 1))::float8 as g_votes_recv_91_per_post,
  ((h_edit_all + 1) / (h_all + 1))::float8 as g_edit_share,
  (case when f_dsl_activity = dsl_post then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_last_post,
  (case when f_dsl_activity = dsl_comment then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_last_comment,
  (case when f_dsl_activity = dsl_hist then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_last_hist,
  (case when f_dsl_activity = dsl_badge then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_last_badge,
  (case when f_dsl_activity <= 30 then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_active_30,
  (case when f_dsl_activity <= 91 then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_active_91,
  (case when dsf_post <= 91 then 1 else 0 end)::float8 as g_new_user
from c

program.sql_full:
with ev as (
  select r.nct_id, r.date,
    sum(coalesce(r.subjects_affected,0)) filter (where r.event_type in ('serious','deaths')) as sa,
    sum(coalesce(r.subjects_affected,0)) filter (where r.event_type='deaths') as dth,
    max(coalesce(r.subjects_at_risk,0)) as risk
  from reported_event_totals r group by 1,2
),
cond_day as (
  select cs.condition_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.dth) dth_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n_d
  from conditions_studies cs join ev on ev.nct_id = cs.nct_id group by 1,2
),
cond_cum as (
  select condition_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(dth_d) over w as cum_dth, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk, sum(n_d) over w as cum_n
  from cond_day window w as (partition by condition_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
cond_day_i as (
  select cs.condition_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d
  from conditions_studies cs join ev on ev.nct_id = cs.nct_id
  join studies st on st.nct_id = ev.nct_id and st.study_type='Interventional'
  group by 1,2
),
cond_cum_i as (
  select condition_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk
  from cond_day_i window w as (partition by condition_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
sp_day as (
  select sp.sponsor_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.dth) dth_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n_d
  from sponsors_studies sp join ev on ev.nct_id = sp.nct_id
  where sp.lead_or_collaborator='lead' group by 1,2
),
sp_cum as (
  select sponsor_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(dth_d) over w as cum_dth, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk, sum(n_d) over w as cum_n
  from sp_day window w as (partition by sponsor_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
gy as (
  select st.phase, date_trunc('month', ev.date) mth, sum(ev.sa) sa, sum(ev.risk) risk, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n
  from ev join studies st on st.nct_id=ev.nct_id group by 1,2
),
gy_cum as (
  select phase, mth, sum(sa) over w as cum_sa, sum(risk) over w as cum_risk, sum(n) over w as cum_n
  from gy window w as (partition by phase order by mth rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
b as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    st.enrollment as enrollment,
    ln(1+coalesce(st.enrollment,0)) as log_enrollment,
    (st.enrollment is null)::int as enrollment_null,
    (st.enrollment_type = 'Anticipated')::int as enrollment_anticipated,
    case st.phase when 'Early Phase 1' then 1 when 'Phase 1' then 2 when 'Phase 1/Phase 2' then 3 when 'Phase 2' then 4
      when 'Phase 2/Phase 3' then 5 when 'Phase 3' then 6 when 'Phase 4' then 7 else 0 end as phase_code,
    (st.phase is null)::int as phase_null,
    (st.study_type='Interventional')::int as is_interventional,
    (st.study_type='Observational')::int as is_observational,
    (st.study_type='Expanded Access')::int as is_expanded,
    st.number_of_arms, st.number_of_groups,
    (st.has_dmc='t')::int as has_dmc,
    (st.is_fda_regulated_drug='t')::int as fda_drug,
    (st.is_fda_regulated_device='t')::int as fda_device,
    case st.source_class when 'INDUSTRY' then 1 when 'NIH' then 2 when 'OTHER_GOV' then 3 when 'FED' then 4
      when 'NETWORK' then 5 when 'INDIV' then 6 when 'AMBIG' then 7 else 8 end as source_class_code,
    (st.plan_to_share_ipd='Yes')::int as share_ipd,
    extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - st.start_date))/86400.0 as days_since_start,
    extract(year from st.start_date) as start_year,
    extract(month from st.start_date) as start_month,
    extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - st.start_date))/86400.0/365.25 as years_since_start,
    length(coalesce(st.brief_title,''))::double precision as len_brief_title,
    length(coalesce(st.official_title,''))::double precision as len_official_title,
    length(coalesce(st.detailed_descriptions,''))::double precision as len_desc,
    length(coalesce(st.brief_summaries,''))::double precision as len_summary,
    (coalesce(st.detailed_descriptions,'')='')::int as no_desc,
    st.phase as phase_txt
  from {seeds} s
  left join studies st on st.nct_id = s.nct_id and st.start_date <= s.seed_time
),
d as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    (d.allocation='Randomized')::int as is_randomized,
    (d.intervention_model='Parallel Assignment')::int as is_parallel,
    (d.intervention_model='Single Group Assignment')::int as is_single_group,
    (d.intervention_model='Crossover Assignment')::int as is_crossover,
    (d.masking in ('Double','Triple','Quadruple'))::int as is_masked,
    (d.masking='None (Open Label)')::int as is_open_label,
    case when d.primary_purpose is null then 0 when d.primary_purpose='Treatment' then 1 when d.primary_purpose='Prevention' then 2
      when d.primary_purpose='Diagnostic' then 3 when d.primary_purpose='Supportive Care' then 4
      when d.primary_purpose='Basic Science' then 5 when d.primary_purpose='Screening' then 6 else 7 end as purpose_code,
    (d.time_perspective='Retrospective')::int as is_retrospective,
    (d.time_perspective='Prospective')::int as is_prospective,
    (d.observational_model is not null)::int as has_obs_model,
    (d.subject_masked='t')::int as subject_masked,
    (d.caregiver_masked='t')::int as caregiver_masked,
    (d.investigator_masked='t')::int as investigator_masked
  from {seeds} s left join designs d on d.nct_id=s.nct_id and d.date<=s.seed_time
),
e as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    (e.gender='Female')::int as gender_female,
    (e.gender='Male')::int as gender_male,
    (e.adult='t')::int as elig_adult,
    (e.child='t')::int as elig_child,
    (e.older_adult='t')::int as elig_older_adult,
    (e.healthy_volunteers='Accepts Healthy Volunteers')::int as healthy_volunteers,
    case when e.minimum_age ~ '^[0-9]+' then
      (regexp_replace(e.minimum_age,'[^0-9.].*$',''))::double precision *
      (case when e.minimum_age ilike '%month%' then 1/12.0 when e.minimum_age ilike '%week%' then 1/52.0
            when e.minimum_age ilike '%day%' then 1/365.0 when e.minimum_age ilike '%hour%' then 1/8760.0 else 1 end)
      else null end as min_age_years,
    case when e.maximum_age ~ '^[0-9]+' then
      (regexp_replace(e.maximum_age,'[^0-9.].*$',''))::double precision *
      (case when e.maximum_age ilike '%month%' then 1/12.0 when e.maximum_age ilike '%week%' then 1/52.0
            when e.maximum_age ilike '%day%' then 1/365.0 when e.maximum_age ilike '%hour%' then 1/8760.0 else 1 end)
      else null end as max_age_years,
    length(coalesce(e.criteria,''))::double precision as len_criteria,
    (e.sampling_method is not null)::int as has_sampling_method
  from {seeds} s left join eligibilities e on e.nct_id=s.nct_id and e.date<=s.seed_time
),
sp as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    coalesce(count(x.sponsor_id),0)::double precision as n_sponsor_links,
    count(distinct x.sponsor_id)::double precision as n_sponsors,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='lead')::int),0)::double precision as n_lead,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='collaborator')::int),0)::double precision as n_collab,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class='INDUSTRY')::int),0)::double precision as n_industry,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class='NIH')::int),0)::double precision as n_nih,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class in ('NETWORK','OTHER_GOV','FED'))::int),0)::double precision as n_gov,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='lead' and spn.agency_class='INDUSTRY')::int),0)::double precision as lead_industry,
    min(case when x.lead_or_collaborator='lead' then x.sponsor_id end) as lead_sponsor_id
  from {seeds} s
  left join sponsors_studies x on x.nct_id=s.nct_id and x.date<=s.seed_time
  left join sponsors spn on spn.sponsor_id=x.sponsor_id
  group by 1,2
),
co as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    count(cs.condition_id)::double precision as n_conditions,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(cancer|carcinoma|tumor|tumour|neoplasm|leukemia|lymphoma|myeloma|melanoma|sarcoma|metasta|adenoma|glioma|blastoma)')::int),0)::double precision as n_oncology,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(hiv|hepatitis|infect|sepsis|tuberculosis|pneumonia|covid|influenza)')::int),0)::double precision as n_infection,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(failure|infarction|disease|syndrom|disorder|hypertens|diabetes|obes|asthma|copd|arthrit|depress|schizophren|alzheimer|parkinson|stroke|pain)')::int),0)::double precision as n_chronic,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '^(healthy|normal)')::int),0)::double precision as n_healthy_condition
  from {seeds} s
  left join conditions_studies cs on cs.nct_id=s.nct_id and cs.date<=s.seed_time
  left join conditions c on c.condition_id=cs.condition_id
  group by 1,2
),
fa as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    count(fs.facility_id)::double precision as n_facilities,
    count(distinct fc.country)::double precision as n_countries,
    (count(distinct fc.country) filter (where fc.country='United States'))::double precision as n_us_facilities
  from {seeds} s
  left join facilities_studies fs on fs.nct_id=s.nct_id and fs.date<=s.seed_time
  left join facilities fc on fc.facility_id=fs.facility_id
  group by 1,2
),
iv as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    count(i.intervention_id)::double precision as n_interventions,
    count(distinct i.intervention_id)::double precision as n_interventions_distinct
  from {seeds} s
  left join interventions_studies i on i.nct_id=s.nct_id and i.date<=s.seed_time
  group by 1,2
),
cond_feat as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time, cs.condition_id,
    max(x.cum_sa) cs_sa, max(x.cum_dth) cs_dth, max(x.cum_risk) cs_risk, max(x.cum_n) cs_n,
    max(y.cum_sa) csi_sa, max(y.cum_risk) csi_risk
  from {seeds} s
  join conditions_studies cs on cs.nct_id=s.nct_id and cs.date<=s.seed_time
  left join cond_cum x on x.condition_id=cs.condition_id and x.date<=s.seed_time
  left join cond_cum_i y on y.condition_id=cs.condition_id and y.date<=s.seed_time
  group by 1,2,3
),
cd as (
  select nct_id, seed_time,
    sum(coalesce(cs_sa,0))::double precision as cond_hist_sa,
    sum(coalesce(cs_dth,0))::double precision as cond_hist_dth,
    sum(coalesce(cs_risk,0))::double precision as cond_hist_risk,
    sum(coalesce(cs_n,0))::double precision as cond_hist_n,
    sum(coalesce(csi_sa,0))::double precision as cond_int_sa,
    sum(coalesce(csi_risk,0))::double precision as cond_int_risk,
    count(*)::double precision as cond_hist_cnt
  from cond_feat group by 1,2
),
spf as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    max(x.cum_sa)::double precision as sp_hist_sa,
    max(x.cum_dth)::double precision as sp_hist_dth,
    max(x.cum_risk)::double precision as sp_hist_risk,
    max(x.cum_n)::double precision as sp_hist_n
  from {seeds} s
  join sp on sp.nct_id=s.nct_id and sp.seed_time=s.seed_time and sp.lead_sponsor_id is not null
  left join sp_cum x on x.sponsor_id=sp.lead_sponsor_id and x.date<=s.seed_time
  group by 1,2
),
gfe as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    max(y.cum_sa)::double precision as gy_sa,
    max(y.cum_risk)::double precision as gy_risk,
    max(y.cum_n)::double precision as gy_n
  from {seeds} s
  join b on b.nct_id=s.nct_id and b.seed_time=s.seed_time
  left join gy_cum y on y.phase = b.phase_txt and y.mth < date_trunc('month', s.seed_time)

program.sql_full:
with ev as (
  select r.nct_id, r.date,
    sum(coalesce(r.subjects_affected,0)) filter (where r.event_type in ('serious','deaths')) as sa,
    sum(coalesce(r.subjects_affected,0)) filter (where r.event_type='deaths') as dth,
    max(coalesce(r.subjects_at_risk,0)) as risk
  from reported_event_totals r group by 1,2
),
cond_day as (
  select cs.condition_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.dth) dth_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n_d
  from conditions_studies cs join ev on ev.nct_id = cs.nct_id group by 1,2
),
cond_cum as (
  select condition_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(dth_d) over w as cum_dth, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk, sum(n_d) over w as cum_n
  from cond_day window w as (partition by condition_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
cond_day_i as (
  select cs.condition_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d
  from conditions_studies cs join ev on ev.nct_id = cs.nct_id
  join studies st on st.nct_id = ev.nct_id and st.study_type='Interventional'
  group by 1,2
),
cond_cum_i as (
  select condition_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk
  from cond_day_i window w as (partition by condition_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
sp_day as (
  select sp.sponsor_id, ev.date, sum(ev.sa) sa_d, sum(ev.dth) dth_d, sum(ev.risk) risk_d, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n_d
  from sponsors_studies sp join ev on ev.nct_id = sp.nct_id
  where sp.lead_or_collaborator='lead' group by 1,2
),
sp_cum as (
  select sponsor_id, date,
    sum(sa_d) over w as cum_sa, sum(dth_d) over w as cum_dth, sum(risk_d) over w as cum_risk, sum(n_d) over w as cum_n
  from sp_day window w as (partition by sponsor_id order by date rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
gy as (
  select st.phase, date_trunc('month', ev.date) mth, sum(ev.sa) sa, sum(ev.risk) risk, count(distinct ev.nct_id) n
  from ev join studies st on st.nct_id=ev.nct_id group by 1,2
),
gy_cum as (
  select phase, mth, sum(sa) over w as cum_sa, sum(risk) over w as cum_risk, sum(n) over w as cum_n
  from gy window w as (partition by phase order by mth rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
b as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    st.enrollment as enrollment,
    ln(1+coalesce(st.enrollment,0)) as log_enrollment,
    (st.enrollment is null)::int as enrollment_null,
    (st.enrollment_type = 'Anticipated')::int as enrollment_anticipated,
    case st.phase when 'Early Phase 1' then 1 when 'Phase 1' then 2 when 'Phase 1/Phase 2' then 3 when 'Phase 2' then 4
      when 'Phase 2/Phase 3' then 5 when 'Phase 3' then 6 when 'Phase 4' then 7 else 0 end as phase_code,
    (st.phase is null)::int as phase_null,
    (st.study_type='Interventional')::int as is_interventional,
    (st.study_type='Observational')::int as is_observational,
    (st.study_type='Expanded Access')::int as is_expanded,
    st.number_of_arms, st.number_of_groups,
    (st.has_dmc='t')::int as has_dmc,
    (st.is_fda_regulated_drug='t')::int as fda_drug,
    (st.is_fda_regulated_device='t')::int as fda_device,
    case st.source_class when 'INDUSTRY' then 1 when 'NIH' then 2 when 'OTHER_GOV' then 3 when 'FED' then 4
      when 'NETWORK' then 5 when 'INDIV' then 6 when 'AMBIG' then 7 else 8 end as source_class_code,
    (st.plan_to_share_ipd='Yes')::int as share_ipd,
    extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - st.start_date))/86400.0 as days_since_start,
    extract(year from st.start_date) as start_year,
    extract(month from st.start_date) as start_month,
    extract(epoch from (s.seed_time - st.start_date))/86400.0/365.25 as years_since_start,
    length(coalesce(st.brief_title,''))::double precision as len_brief_title,
    length(coalesce(st.official_title,''))::double precision as len_official_title,
    length(coalesce(st.detailed_descriptions,''))::double precision as len_desc,
    length(coalesce(st.brief_summaries,''))::double precision as len_summary,
    (coalesce(st.detailed_descriptions,'')='')::int as no_desc,
    st.phase as phase_txt
  from {seeds} s
  left join studies st on st.nct_id = s.nct_id and st.start_date <= s.seed_time
),
d as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    (d.allocation='Randomized')::int as is_randomized,
    (d.intervention_model='Parallel Assignment')::int as is_parallel,
    (d.intervention_model='Single Group Assignment')::int as is_single_group,
    (d.intervention_model='Crossover Assignment')::int as is_crossover,
    (d.masking in ('Double','Triple','Quadruple'))::int as is_masked,
    (d.masking='None (Open Label)')::int as is_open_label,
    case when d.primary_purpose is null then 0 when d.primary_purpose='Treatment' then 1 when d.primary_purpose='Prevention' then 2
      when d.primary_purpose='Diagnostic' then 3 when d.primary_purpose='Supportive Care' then 4
      when d.primary_purpose='Basic Science' then 5 when d.primary_purpose='Screening' then 6 else 7 end as purpose_code,
    (d.time_perspective='Retrospective')::int as is_retrospective,
    (d.time_perspective='Prospective')::int as is_prospective,
    (d.observational_model is not null)::int as has_obs_model,
    (d.subject_masked='t')::int as subject_masked,
    (d.caregiver_masked='t')::int as caregiver_masked,
    (d.investigator_masked='t')::int as investigator_masked
  from {seeds} s left join designs d on d.nct_id=s.nct_id and d.date<=s.seed_time
),
e as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    (e.gender='Female')::int as gender_female,
    (e.gender='Male')::int as gender_male,
    (e.adult='t')::int as elig_adult,
    (e.child='t')::int as elig_child,
    (e.older_adult='t')::int as elig_older_adult,
    (e.healthy_volunteers='Accepts Healthy Volunteers')::int as healthy_volunteers,
    case when e.minimum_age ~ '^[0-9]+' then
      (regexp_replace(e.minimum_age,'[^0-9.].*$',''))::double precision *
      (case when e.minimum_age ilike '%month%' then 1/12.0 when e.minimum_age ilike '%week%' then 1/52.0
            when e.minimum_age ilike '%day%' then 1/365.0 when e.minimum_age ilike '%hour%' then 1/8760.0 else 1 end)
      else null end as min_age_years,
    case when e.maximum_age ~ '^[0-9]+' then
      (regexp_replace(e.maximum_age,'[^0-9.].*$',''))::double precision *
      (case when e.maximum_age ilike '%month%' then 1/12.0 when e.maximum_age ilike '%week%' then 1/52.0
            when e.maximum_age ilike '%day%' then 1/365.0 when e.maximum_age ilike '%hour%' then 1/8760.0 else 1 end)
      else null end as max_age_years,
    length(coalesce(e.criteria,''))::double precision as len_criteria,
    (e.sampling_method is not null)::int as has_sampling_method
  from {seeds} s left join eligibilities e on e.nct_id=s.nct_id and e.date<=s.seed_time
),
sp as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    coalesce(count(x.sponsor_id),0)::double precision as n_sponsor_links,
    count(distinct x.sponsor_id)::double precision as n_sponsors,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='lead')::int),0)::double precision as n_lead,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='collaborator')::int),0)::double precision as n_collab,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class='INDUSTRY')::int),0)::double precision as n_industry,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class='NIH')::int),0)::double precision as n_nih,
    coalesce(sum((spn.agency_class in ('NETWORK','OTHER_GOV','FED'))::int),0)::double precision as n_gov,
    coalesce(sum((x.lead_or_collaborator='lead' and spn.agency_class='INDUSTRY')::int),0)::double precision as lead_industry,
    min(case when x.lead_or_collaborator='lead' then x.sponsor_id end) as lead_sponsor_id
  from {seeds} s
  left join sponsors_studies x on x.nct_id=s.nct_id and x.date<=s.seed_time
  left join sponsors spn on spn.sponsor_id=x.sponsor_id
  group by 1,2
),
co as (
  select s.nct_id, s.seed_time,
    count(cs.condition_id)::double precision as n_conditions,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(cancer|carcinoma|tumor|tumour|neoplasm|leukemia|lymphoma|myeloma|melanoma|sarcoma|metasta|adenoma|glioma|blastoma)')::int),0)::double precision as n_oncology,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(hiv|hepatitis|infect|sepsis|tuberculosis|pneumonia|covid|influenza)')::int),0)::double precision as n_infection,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '(failure|infarction|disease|syndrom|disorder|hypertens|diabetes|obes|asthma|copd|arthrit|depress|schizophren|alzheimer|parkinson|stroke|pain)')::int),0)::double precision as n_chronic,
    coalesce(sum((c.mesh_term ~* '^(healthy|normal)')::int),0)::double precision as n_healthy_condition
  from {seeds} s
  left join conditions_studies cs on cs.nct_id=s.nct_id and cs.date<=s.seed_time
  left join conditions c on c.condition_id=cs.condition_id
  group by 1,2

fa as (

  from {seeds} s

  from {seeds} s

),
